item.title: The Writers Guild at Bloomington: First Sunday Prose Reading Series — Sun Oct 4, 4:00 PM — Juniper Art Gallery
item.description:
The Writers Guild will feature a special play reading edition. Local playwright Annalise Cain and a group of actors will read from one of Annalise's new plays, with Open Mic to follow!
Annalise's Bio:
Hailing from the backroads of Massachusetts, Annalise Cain is a playwright and the managing director of Stages Bloomington. Her plays have been produced by Red Theater and Emerging Artists Theatre Festival. She's won the National Partners of the American Theatre Playwriting Award. BFA, Boston University. MFA in Playwriting, IU.
Source: Pillar Arts Community Calendar

item.title: Early Birds - — Tue Oct 6, 1:00 PM — Bryan Park Parking Lot
item.description:
If no ride is listed, then riders should feel free to choose a suitable route.This group emphasizes earlier, moderate-paced rides with routes planned in advance and posted on the ride calendar. This is a no drop ride, but not a beginner's ride. Expect an overall average moving speed of 12 - 15 mph. Distances vary from 20 to a little over 30 miles. Early season rides will be at the lower end of the distance scale. During colder weather the ride departs at 1:00pm. Non-members should sign up for a free trial membership, good for up to three rides, and which includes electronically signing a liability waiver, prior to participation.
